_readme: The Education library. One entry per book file in this folder.
Adding a book: drop the .docx or .epub into /books/ and add an entry with
its file name and a slug. Everything else — title, author, chapters,
headings, tables, images, contents list — is read out of the file itself,
so nothing here needs a new HTML page, a database row or a rebuild.
title / subtitle / author / description are optional. They are only used
for the library card, so the card can render without downloading the whole
book. Leave them out and the card falls back to the file name; the reader
always shows what the file itself says.
Access is not set per book. The whole Education section is gated as one
thing: signed in, and approved by an admin.
